```nix
    TOOLS_DIR="$REPL_HOME/.local/tools"

      cd "$TOOLS_DIR"
      rm -rf "$ZIG_DIR" "zig-linux-x86_64-$ZIG_VERSION.tar.xz"
      wget -q ""
      tar -xJf "zig-x86_64-linux-$ZIG_VERSION.tar.xz"
      rm "zig-x86_64-linux-$ZIG_VERSION.tar.xz"

    if [ ! -x "$FUTHARK_DIR/bin/futhark" ]; then
      cd "$TOOLS_DIR"
      rm -rf "$FUTHARK_DIR" "futhark-$FUTHARK_VERSION-linux-x86_64.tar.xz"

      tar -xJf "futhark-$FUTHARK_VERSION-linux-x86_64.tar.xz"

    export CUDA_BASE_IMAGE="nvidia/cuda:12.8.1-devel-ubuntu24.04"
    export CUDA_VERSION="12.8.1"
  '';
}
```

scripts/setup-toolchain.sh
```bash
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

CUDA_BASE_IMAGE="nvidia/cuda:12.8.1-devel-ubuntu24.04"
CUDA_VERSION="12.8.1"
FUTHARK_VERSION="0.26.4"
ZIG_VERSION="0.14.1"

REPL_HOME="${REPL_HOME:-$HOME}"
TOOLCHAIN_ROOT="${TOOLCHAIN_ROOT:-$REPL_HOME/.local/toolchains}"
BIN_DIR="$TOOLCHAIN_ROOT/bin"
DOWNLOAD_DIR="$TOOLCHAIN_ROOT/downloads"
ZIG_DIR="$TOOLCHAIN_ROOT/zig-x86_64-linux-$ZIG_VERSION"
FUTHARK_DIR="$TOOLCHAIN_ROOT/futhark-$FUTHARK_VERSION-linux-x86_64"

mkdir -p "$BIN_DIR" "$DOWNLOAD_DIR"

if [ ! -x "$ZIG_DIR/zig" ]; then
  archive="$DOWNLOAD_DIR/zig-x86_64-linux-$ZIG_VERSION.tar.xz"
  rm -rf "$ZIG_DIR"
  curl --fail --location --retry 3 --output "$archive" ""
  tar --extract --xz --file "$archive" --directory "$TOOLCHAIN_ROOT"
  rm -f "$archive"
fi

if [ ! -x "$FUTHARK_DIR/bin/futhark" ]; then
  archive="$DOWNLOAD_DIR/futhark-$FUTHARK_VERSION-linux-x86_64.tar.xz"
  rm -rf "$FUTHARK_DIR"
  curl --fail --location --retry 3 --output "$archive" ""
  tar --extract --xz --file "$archive" --directory "$TOOLCHAIN_ROOT"
  rm -f "$archive"
fi

ln -sfn "$ZIG_DIR/zig" "$BIN_DIR/zig"
ln -sfn "$FUTHARK_DIR/bin/futhark" "$BIN_DIR/futhark"

cat > "$TOOLCHAIN_ROOT/environment.sh" <<EOF
export CUDA_BASE_IMAGE="$CUDA_BASE_IMAGE"
export CUDA_VERSION="$CUDA_VERSION"
export PATH="$BIN_DIR:\$PATH"
export PYTHON_BIN="$(command -v python3.11)"
export ZIG_HOME="$ZIG_DIR"
export FUTHARK_HOME="$FUTHARK_DIR"
EOF

printf '%s\n' "CUDA base image: $CUDA_BASE_IMAGE"
python3.11 --version
"$BIN_DIR/zig" version
"$BIN_DIR/futhark" --version
```

```bash
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

REPL_HOME="${REPL_HOME:-$HOME}"

if [ ! -f "$ENVIRONMENT_FILE" ]; then

futhark --version | grep -F '0.26.4'

printf '%s\n' "CUDA base image: $CUDA_BASE_IMAGE"
printf '%s\n' "CUDA version: $CUDA_VERSION"
printf '%s\n' "Python: $(python3.11 --version)"
printf '%s\n' "Zig: $(zig version)"
printf '%s\n' "Futhark: $(futhark --version)"
```

main.py
```python
from __future__ import annotations

import os
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys


def command_output(command: list[str]) -> str:
    return subprocess.check_output(command, text=True).strip()


def main() -> None:
    required = {
        "python3.11": ["python3.11", "--version"],
        "zig": ["zig", "version"],
        "futhark": ["futhark", "--version"],
    }

    missing = [name for name in required if shutil.which(name) is None]

    if missing:
        raise RuntimeError(f"Missing required executables: {', '.join(missing)}")

    print(f"CUDA_BASE_IMAGE={os.environ['CUDA_BASE_IMAGE']}")
    print(f"CUDA_VERSION={os.environ['CUDA_VERSION']}")
    print(f"PYTHON={command_output(required['python3.11'])}")
    print(f"ZIG={command_output(required['zig'])}")
    print(f"FUTHARK={command_output(required['futhark'])}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main() or 0)
```
